description.en: DSH 桌面端（DeepSeek Harness）插件：编辑会话里的助手回复与思维链，让模型采信改后的内容—在线写入立即生效。Plugin: Edit the assistant's responses and thought chains within sessions, enabling the model to adopt the modified content — online writing takes effect immediately.
description.zh: 编辑 DSH 会话中的助手回复与思维链，让模型采信改后的内容：在线经 message projection 立即生效，或落盘改写会话记录。

description.en: A tiny DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin
Remote access and mobile sync bridge for DSH iOS App with QR pairing, screen-lock resume, and tunnel management.
description.zh: 专为 DSH iOS App 与移动端协同打造的远程连接插件，支持扫码配对、锁屏恢复与隧道管理。

description.en: Plays a full-screen video while DeepSeek Harness starts and reveals the UI only after it ends. Esc skips it.
description.zh: 打开 DeepSeek Harness 时全屏播放一段开机视频，播完才露出界面，按 Esc 可跳过。

description.en: Luna preset for DeepSeek Harness — a little-demon persona on the full standard tool set, composed by six deterministic rule layers (perception, understanding, state, style, regulation, memory) plus a derived vitals layer, with a gated, suppressible cross-session memory file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的露娜预设：小恶魔人设配完整的 standard 工具面，由感知、理解、状态、表达、调节、记忆六层确定性规则驱动，外加生理派生层；跨会话记忆写入经证据门控，遗忘用抑制而非删除。

description.en: Hello Kitty pink theme skin for the DSH Web UI: overrides the --dsw-alias-* semantic tokens in light and dark mode and paints a custom wallpaper on the app frame. Installs as a static profile plugin, so the theme restores automatically on every Harness start.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的 Hello Kitty 粉色主题皮肤：覆盖 --dsw-alias-* 语义 token（浅色/深色），并给主框架铺上自定义壁纸；作为静态 profile 插件安装，Harness 每次启动自动恢复。

description.en: DeepSeek-led background orchestration of Codex and DSH subagents, with existing conversation handoff, Markdown history, quota pauses, and bounded decision retries.
description.zh: 由 DeepSeek 主导后台调度 Codex 和 DSH 子对话，支持已有对话接管、Markdown 历史、额度暂停和有限决策重试。

description.en: Pair a phone with this computer's DSH instance by QR code or a six-digit code, then drive it remotely — send instructions, view images, answer approvals — from the panel, with public-tunnel support for pairing across networks.
description.zh: 用二维码或六位配对码把手机连上这台电脑的 DSH，之后可远程发指令、看图片、回答审批；局域网内不依赖云端，异地走公网隧道。

description.en: Hold Ctrl and roll the mouse wheel to zoom the whole Harness Web UI around the pointer, 50-200% in 10% steps; Ctrl +/- and Ctrl 0 from the keyboard; a bottom-right chip and a Page zoom row in Settings → General show and reset the level.
description.zh: 按住 Ctrl 滚动鼠标滚轮即可缩放整个 Harness 网页界面，以指针位置为锚点、50%–200% 每档 10%；另支持 Ctrl 加减号与 Ctrl+0 快捷键；右下角缩放胶囊与「设置 → 通用」里的页面缩放行显示当前档位并可一键复位；档位保存在 localStorage。

description.en: Fonts and code-font settings for the UI with an English-only glyph scale (100-160%), a -4..+8 px content-size offset that actually applies, and settings kept across refreshes - a maintained fork of lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts.
description.zh: 在设置页自定义界面中英文与代码字体，支持只放大拉丁字形的英文字形缩放（100-160%）与 -4..+8 px 的内容字号偏移，刷新后保留设置；lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts 的维护分支。

description.en: An embedded Douyin window docked in the DSH sidebar: a real Electron webview guest, so douyin.com's X-Frame-Options: DENY no longer applies.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏底部的内嵌抖音窗口：用 Electron webview 租约绕过 douyin.com 的 X-Frame-Options: DENY。仅桌面版。

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort card for the composer: takes over the model selector and shows the current level, the model row and a segmented slider over the model's own adapter-provided levels, with a model list, a reset, and a purple aurora with twinkling particles at the maximum level.
description.zh: 输入框里的 Codex 风格推理强度卡片：接管模型选择器，显示当前档位、模型行，以及覆盖模型适配器所报全部档位的分段滑块；另带模型列表、重置，以及最高档时的紫色极光与闪烁粒子。

description.en: Session favorites: bookmark any conversation into a browser-style favorites panel — one-click star from session rows, folders for organization, notes, custom display names, resume session, fork into a new session, basic session stats, plus a fork-relationship graph showing how conversations derive from one another.
description.zh: 会话收藏夹：把任意会话收藏进浏览器收藏夹式的管理面板——左侧会话行一键收藏/星标，主面板支持文件夹分门别类、备注、自定义显示名、一键继续会话、Fork 新会话、会话基本统计，外加一张清晰展示会话派生关系的 fork 关系图。

description.en: One-click thumbs up/down rating UI plus a feedback bridge: ratings are collected to JSONL and a short summary of unconsumed feedback is injected into model context before each request.
description.zh: 一键点赞/点踩评分 UI 加反馈桥接：评分采集落盘 JSONL，并在每次请求前把未消费的反馈摘要注入模型上下文。

description.en: A global permission watchdog: a hard budget on auto-approved permission requests. At most 10 per rolling 60 seconds, at least 3 seconds apart; anything past either limit is deferred to the human answerer and waits. It never refuses and never changes what is asked -- it only decides who answers and how fast. Installs disabled; enable it with the plugin manager toggle.
description.zh: 全局权限看门狗：为审批请求设一道硬性总额度。滚动 60 秒内最多自动通过 10 次，且两次之间至少间隔 3 秒；超出任一上限的请求一律转交人工应答并等待。它从不拒绝、也不改变请求内容，只决定谁来答、答得多快。安装后默认关闭，需在插件管理器中手动开启。

description.en: Publishes the desktop shell's file-path bridge as the host-path seam the composer reads, so files and folders dropped into the composer become @path references instead of uploaded copies (images still upload through the native image channel).
description.zh: 把桌面壳的文件路径桥接发布为输入框读取的 host-path 接口，让拖入输入框的文件与文件夹变成 @path 引用而不是上传副本（图片仍走原生图片通道上传）。

description.en: Pixel-art Little Red Riding Hood pet for the DSH session window: transparent and always on top, it walks back and forth along the composer, blinks, looks around, turns its head toward the cursor, sleeps on double-click, and scales from 2x to 7x in a right-click panel.
description.zh: 会话窗口里的像素桌宠「小红帽蕾克」：透明无边框、始终置顶，在输入框上沿来回走动，会眨眼、张望、蹦跳，鼠标靠近会转头看你，双击原地睡觉，右键面板可调 2×~7× 大小。

description.en: Local token totals, per-model usage and a 12-week heatmap in a Chinese sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在中文侧栏面板中展示本地 Token 总量、模型用量与 12 周热力图。

description.en: Multi-model deliberation pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: independent proposals, blind peer review, program-executed evidence verification, immutable revision and independent acceptance on a fresh context.
description.zh: DSH 多模型协作研讨插件：独立提案、互审、证据核验、完整稿修订与新上下文验收。

description.en: Full-page NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH: daily recommendations, playlist browsing by category, charts, new releases, search, playlist/album/artist pages, QR-code login, synced lyrics, queue and downloads, plus four agent tools for search, song URLs, lyrics and playlist tracks.
description.zh: 整页式网易云音乐播放器：每日推荐、按分类浏览歌单广场、排行榜、新碟上架、搜索、歌单/专辑/歌手页、扫码登录、逐行歌词、队列与下载，并提供搜索、歌曲直链、歌词、歌单曲目四个 agent 工具。

description.en: Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers: KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI-output screenshot reading, online manual lookup with cited sources, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only.
description.zh: 网络工程师助手预设 + 四厂商（迪普/新华三/华为/锐捷）交换机路由器命令知识库：32 篇文档随插件以技能形式分发（含来源链接与 verified 分级），KB 优先检索、跨厂商语法对照、拓扑与回显截图识别、联网查官方手册并注明出处、高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；只回答网络工程主题。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DSH desktop sessions from the host process: turn ends, approvals, questions and a reminder for an unanswered wait, with a selectable sound per situation and imported custom sound files; clicking a toast raises the DSH window.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端会话的 Windows 原生 Toast 通知（宿主侧）：回合结束、审批、提问与未应答催办，按情况可选音效并支持导入自定义音效；点击通知把 DSH 窗口拉回前台。

description.en: Host-wide MCP server panel: imports the servers declared in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI configs, searches six upstream catalogs and installs from whichever of them declares an install plan, asks only for the fields a server actually declares, and checks each row for whether the mount, the handshake and its tool list really work.
description.zh: 全局 MCP 服务面板：导入 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、Codex CLI 配置里声明的服务，检索六个上游目录并只从声明了安装方案的条目安装，只询问服务器自己声明过的配置项，并对每一行检查挂载、握手与工具表是否真的可用。

description.en: Quiet break, water, long-session and late-night reminders delivered by three bundled chibi companions, with cloud bubbles and a light bounce. Works in-page without extra downloads; the optional macOS desktop window uses a separately downloaded Electron helper.
description.zh: 用三套内置 Q 版角色提供久坐、喝水、连续工作与深夜关怀，带云朵气泡和轻回弹；页面内显示无需额外下载，可选 macOS 桌面窗口使用单独下载的 Electron 组件。

description.en: Switch DSH's built-in web_search between the DeepSeek Search API (/v1/tools/search) and the default account search, with automatic fallback, a settings page and a sidebar switch.
description.zh: 给 DSH 内置 web_search 加一个开关：在 DeepSeek Search API（/v1/tools/search）与默认账号搜索之间切换，失败自动回退，并带设置页与侧栏开关。

description.en: Windows-only power card injected into the DSH page: the artwork carries two hit zones (left shuts down, right restarts), the first click only turns the card into a yes/no question and the second click fires, and the restart engine stops only this instance's process tree, waits for the port to free, relaunches outside the host's Job Object and confirms the new instance answers on the plugin's own status route.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows：注入 DSH 页面的电源卡片，图案左右各带一块命中区（左关机、右重启），第一次点击只把卡片变成一句是否确认，第二次点击才执行；重启引擎只停本实例的进程树，等待端口释放后在宿主 Job Object 之外重新拉起，并用插件自己的状态路由确认新实例已经应答。

description.en: Pinned prompt shortcuts in a single row above the composer — one click replaces the draft with the saved text — plus a searchable panel for pinning, editing and deleting prompts, overflow collapsed into a "More" menu, storage in a Host-side JSON file, and a prompt_shortcuts agent tool that reads and writes the same file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的一行置顶提示词按钮，点击即替换草稿内容；另有可搜索的维护面板用于置顶、编辑、删除，放不下的按钮收进「更多」菜单，数据存于 Host 侧 JSON 文件，并注册 prompt_shortcuts 工具读写同一份数据。

description.en: Community-maintained dsh-purge fork with host-policy patches, prompt and rule settings, diagnostics, separate update-check and install controls, and local backup/rollback.
description.zh: 独立维护的 dsh-purge 社区分支，提供宿主策略补丁、提示词与规则设置、诊断、独立的更新检查与安装控制，以及本机备份回滚。

description.en: Fork of dsh-reasoning-effort with a two-level model picker in the composer: a provider list, a model pane that slides out beside it, search, and compact rows, alongside the reasoning-effort slider and its max-level effects.
description.zh: dsh-reasoning-effort 的分支：输入框里的两级模型选择器（Provider 列表 + 右侧滑出的模型栏）、搜索与紧凑行，并保留推理强度滑块与最高档特效。

description.en: Deletes a whole conversation from the sidebar session menu, and opens a right-click menu on a chat text selection with Copy, Quote (insert a Markdown quote block into the composer) and Ask: Ask sends the selection plus your question to one reused continuable subagent (label `ask`, found again through the subagent catalog after a restart) and streams the answer into the right sidebar.
description.zh: 从侧栏会话菜单删除整个会话；聊天里划词右键弹出「复制 / 引用 / 提问」：引用把 Markdown 引用块插入输入框，提问把选区与问题交给同一个复用的可继续子智能体（label `ask`，宿主重启后经子智能体目录找回），回答在右侧栏流式显示。

description.en: Adds a Restart row to the desktop app's sidebar foot beside Settings that restarts the app and reloads the page onto the newly installed plugin bundle.
description.zh: 在桌面版侧边栏底部、「设置」旁边新增一个「重启」按钮，重启应用，并在页面重连后加载到刚安装的插件包。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance above the sidebar account area, the running cost of the open conversation, the cost of each turn beside its token count, and a one-click AI breakdown for any turn above a token threshold.
description.zh: 在侧边栏账户区上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、当前会话累计花费与逐轮费用，并对超出 token 阈值的单轮提供一键 AI 分析。

description.en: One-click prompt refinement for the DSH composer: the ✦ button next to Send rewrites the draft into an agent-ready prompt in Standard or Light mode, with Revert and Retry; asks follow-up questions through the question card when the draft is missing information; checks that paths, identifiers, numbers, URLs, inline code and @mentions survive the rewrite and adds back any that were dropped; runs on the conversation model or a dedicated model chosen on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框一键改写提示词：点「发送」旁的 ✦，按「标准」或「轻」档把草稿改写成 Agent 可直接执行的提示词，可撤回或重试；草稿缺少信息时通过提问卡片追问；校验路径、标识符、数字、URL、行内代码与 @ 提及在改写后逐字保留，丢失的会补回；可使用会话模型，或在插件页面指定专用模型。

description.en: TapTap Maker game-dev workbench with 150+ bundled skills, custom image lane, ChatGPT web with account rotation, CC0 SFX, web BGM, and a forced no-Maker-credit-burn policy.
description.zh: TapTap Maker 游戏开发工作台：内置 150+ 技能、自定义生图通道、ChatGPT 网页多账号轮换、CC0 音效库、网页 BGM，并强制"未经用户同意不花 Maker 额度"。

description.en: Generic monitor plugin for DSH Desktop: an HTTP polling rule engine. Poll any endpoint on schedule (multi-step, variable extraction, JS condition expressions); when conditions hit, wake a visible agent session to act — zero model calls otherwise. Configure everything in a sidebar GUI panel: create/edit/pause/test/fire-now/run history, same UX as the built-in scheduler plugin.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 通用监控插件：HTTP 轮询规则引擎。按规则定时轮询任意接口（多步骤、变量提取、JS 条件表达式），条件命中才唤醒一个可见的 agent 会话执行任务；未命中零模型调用、零 token 消耗。规则通过导航栏 GUI 面板配置：新建/编辑/启停/测试/立即触发/执行记录，与定时任务插件同款交互体验。

description.en: Buckets every model call by local date, provider and model, then shows the totals in a sidebar card, a per-chat pill under the composer and a settings page, alongside each provider's account balance and subscription windows.
description.zh: 把每次模型调用按本地日期、供应商与模型记账，在侧栏卡片、输入框下方的单会话胶囊和设置页里展示用量合计，并同列展示各供应商的账户余额与套餐窗口。

description.en: Read Bilibili and Douyin from a session: WBI-signed Bilibili API calls behind one shared pacer (4 req/s, per-host cooldown after a 412) for video, feed, search, author, comments, danmaku and subtitles, plus Douyin hot list, video, feed and search rendered in a locally launched Edge over CDP.
description.zh: 会话内读 B站与抖音：B站走 WBI 签名接口，全部请求共用一个限速器（默认 4 请求/秒，吃 412 后按主机冷却），覆盖视频、热门、搜索、UP主、评论、弹幕、字幕；抖音则通过 CDP 驱动本机 Edge 渲染，读热榜、视频、推荐流与搜索。

description.en: Reads and writes WPS 365 cloud documents (smart documents and .docx/.xlsx/.pptx) through the locally installed wps365-cli, with conflict checks before writing; requires a WPS 365 enterprise account.
description.zh: 通过本机安装的 wps365-cli 读写 WPS 365 云文档（智能文档与 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx），写入前先做并发冲突比对；需要 WPS 365 企业版账号。

description.en: Select text in a conversation to attach a numbered highlight with a colour stored per note, keep every mark in an outline panel that jumps back to its quote, and let a corner self-check badge report style, selector and saved-key problems without opening dev tools.
description.zh: 在对话里划词加批注：编号高亮、每条各记自己的颜色，大纲面板列出全部标记并点一条跳回原文；右下角自检角标不开开发者工具就报出样式、越界选择器与本地存档键的问题。

description.en: Codex, Grok Build, Cursor, Pi, and ZCode presets on DSH models, with native sessions and optional OMD enhancements.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型与原生会话上提供 Codex、Grok Build、Cursor、Pi、ZCode 预设及可选 OMD 增强。

description.en: Closes ai-memory's consolidation loop for DSH: when a DSH session ends it calls ai-memory finalize-session, so the observations DSH captured become wiki pages the other harnesses ai-memory serves can read. Skips subagents, queues concurrent session ends, and sweeps sessions abandoned by a forced restart.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上 ai-memory 的收敛闭环：DSH 会话结束时调用 ai-memory finalize-session，把本次捕获的观察整理成 wiki 页面，供 ai-memory 服务的其他 harness 读取；跳过子代理、串行化并发结束的会话，并补扫被强制重启遗留的会话。
